Infleqtion, a quantum‑networking startup, and Cisco Systems have announced a partnership aimed at advancing networked quantum technology. The collaboration seeks to integrate Infleqtion’s quantum connectivity solutions with Cisco’s network infrastructure to accelerate the development of secure, future quantum internet capabilities. This announcement was reported by Business Wire.
